items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: Together with her husband Bob Kindred, she composed and directed an iconic holiday production

ctx.x: Anne Phillips has led a distinguished career as a pianist, vocalist, composer, and a much-in-demand producer of television commercials. Together with her husband Bob Kindred, she composed and directed an iconic holiday production entitled “Bending Towards the Light” which has featured prominent jazz musicians in leading roles.
Anne was interviewed via Zoom on February 24, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
